press_references.value: Tabreed Bahrain to expand district cooling network in Manama

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed Bahrain appointed Arabian International Company WLL as EPC contractor to design and build the expansion of its chilled water district cooling network in the northern seafront area of Manama, increasing capacity by 12,000 RT by summer 2027.

press_references.value: Tabreed, Sparklo join forces to boost UAE’s recycling infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed announced a new sustainability-focused partnership with cleantech firm Sparklo to deploy 16 smart reverse vending machines across high-traffic locations in the UAE, boosting recycling of bottles and cans via digital rewards.

press_references.value: Tabreed appoints Arqaam Securities as liquidity provider

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed appointed Arqaam Securities as a licensed liquidity provider for its DFM-listed shares under a 12-month mandate, with services starting 22 October 2025 to enhance trading liquidity.

press_references.value: Tabreed and Johnson Controls enter long-term agreement for development and supply of next generation cooling technology

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed and Johnson Controls signed a long-term framework to co-develop and supply next‑generation centrifugal chillers and lifecycle services for district cooling.

press_references.value: Tabreed revenue hits $302mln; firm announces first interim dividend

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed secured a 250,000 RT exclusive concession for the Palm Jebel Ali project in partnership with Dubai Holding Investments, marking one of the largest strategic deals in its history.

press_references.value: UAE’s Ministry of Defence strengthens its environmental credentials with Tabreed and Emerge

partnership_announcements.description: The UAE Ministry of Defence, Tabreed, and Emerge (a joint venture of Masdar and EDF Group) announced the completion of a partnership project to integrate solar energy into two district cooling plants serving the Ministry's facilities in Abu Dhabi. The agreement, signed in March 2024, involves the installation of 4,000 solar panels to supply clean electricity and reduce CO2 emissions.

press_references.value: Tabreed and Dubai Holding enter agreement to provide District Cooling to Palm Jebel Ali

partnership_announcements.description: Tabreed and Dubai Holding have entered a joint venture to provide district cooling services for Palm Jebel Ali in Dubai, with Tabreed holding a 51% stake and Dubai Holding Investments 49%.
